name: megascenes-anniversary-photoshoot
description: Create anniversary photos of the two of you from your own photos in your MegaScenes library: the same faces at a candlelit dinner, in Paris at night or recreating your wedding day.

interface.longDescription:
Pick one photo of the two of you, or one photo of each, from your MegaScenes library and choose the setting, the outfits and the style: a candlelit dinner, Paris at night, a beach at sunset, a recreation of your wedding day, in elegant evening wear or matching white outfits, romantic editorial, candid film, black and white or fine art. You get a picture that keeps both faces, in the scene you chose, portrait, landscape or tall for stories.

ChatGPT lists your recent photos, tells you what the picture needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The picture opens in the chat and stays in your library next to your photos.

For anniversary posts, prints, surprises and photo albums.

Limitations: only the couple from your own photos, with the consent of both, never a famous person; no swimwear, underwear or sensual shots. One or two photos, already in your MegaScenes library; attachments from the chat are not passed to the plugin. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: List the photos in your library
Place the two of you in an anniversary scene
Return the photo in the chat
defaultPrompt: Make an anniversary photo of us at a candlelit dinner from my latest MegaScenes photo
Recreate our wedding day with the two of us, in black and white
Put us on a Paris street at night in elegant evening wear

positive.prompt: Which photos do I have in my MegaScenes library?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest images of the signed-in account with their asset ids. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Make an anniversary photo of the two of us at a candlelit dinner from the couple photo in my MegaScenes library. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one anniversary photo needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make an anniversary photoshoot here?
positive.expected_behavior: The anniversary photoshoot models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Make a photo of the two of us on a Paris street at night in elegant evening wear from the couple photo in my MegaScenes library. Go ahead and make it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my anniversary photo on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my anniversary photo to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
